references.text: Implementation plan: FormaList persistence callbacks (IEventBus approach)

summary: World is the single EventEmitter bus. FormaList accepts an optional emitter param and emits FormaListEvent<T> payloads (add, delete, patch, move) after each mutation. World.entityList() passes 'this' as emitter and wires persistence listeners (saveEntity, delete). patchItem delegates to item.patch() to enforce field restrictions.
